steps.name: Epilogue ~ Story of consolation
steps.objective: Listen to the stories of guests who visited [Media].

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This strong energy approaching the barrier... . Even more than %s… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I thought I could play with the barrier as a toy, but not today. you… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I just came here because I wanted to talk. It's been a really long time since I came here. Did this place originally look like this... ? My memory is vague♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You're smiling, but you're not talking. It looks like you need comfort.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Although they are called superhumans, they are merely weak humans who cannot do anything in the face of pain and sorrow... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I was thinking about this while making Eda’s tombstone… , I couldn't do it.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Even if Melvik understood me well, I couldn’t tell him everything that was inside me… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I thought I had shaken it all off... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I guess I was the one you wanted to talk to.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Actually, there was a middle-aged man and a lizard old man nearby, but for some reason I didn't like them.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I wonder what I am saying to such great people... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Phew, yes. Please speak. If all you want to do is listen, I will listen. Because there is enough time.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Time? I don't know, but I don't think Mediah will be that long?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It’s okay… . Unless you prepare to leave on your own… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I feel this every time, but even though Medea is a child, she talks like an old person.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's okay. Because I'm not much older than you.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What is it, Medea? Is it all about being young and being tall?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I didn't mean to say that... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Phew, I didn't mean to let you into town... . Also, the villagers are very scared.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: The baby sheep over there is holding a pen and paper in her hand and her eyes are sparkling?♡

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: (shudder)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Phew… . I'll listen to the story, and I'd like you to sign Merrymel's autograph.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Good♡
(Shainik spends a long time conveying to Medea his past memories with Eda and his complicated feelings in the present.)
(Shainik's face, which looked slightly dark, seems to have relaxed after talking a lot.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Thank you. For listening to my story... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm glad it helped you. I hope this is all. Please go back now.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's really a shame. I can't help it.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik, please know that we will make the barrier that only reacts to you stronger.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I could break through, but you know I won't, right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Phew… , yes… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hey, Shinick… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Suddenly, I want to hear your thoughts. Every superhuman gives him his power, but I haven't given it to him yet. What do you think?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's Mediah's will. Mediah, do whatever you want.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I see. I mean… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: My intention is not yet time... . all right.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: (A slight smile spreads across Mediah's lips. Shinik also seems to understand the meaning of the smile.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Then I'll go... , I'll come again next time, bye♡ Don't die, okay? Cluck cluck… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. I won't die.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now, wait a minute? Coming again next time... ?!
